optionDescriptions.aria-label: Accessible name, e.g. Page 1 of 3. With a name the page is an image (a group with textLayer); without one it is decorative.
optionDescriptions.fit: A box the page must fit into.
optionDescriptions.onHighlight: Receives the selected match’s element, e.g. to scroll it into view.
optionDescriptions.onLinkNavigate: An internal link targets another page.
optionDescriptions.rotation: Added to the page’s intrinsic rotation.
optionDescriptions.style: Inline styles on the page element.
